responsibility: Implements the central GNU Modula-2 runtime system services for the boot environment, including module construction/deconstruction delegation to M2Dependent, registration and execution of initial and termination procedures, HALT/Terminate/error-message behavior, runtime LENGTH support, and the family of helper routines that raise specific language/runtime exceptions through RTExceptions. This file is the top-level runtime control and diagnostics layer that coordinates program startup/shutdown and maps language failures into the exception subsystem.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable runtime implementation for the GM2RTS pair: it manages initial/termination procedure lists, delegates module construction to M2Dependent, implements HALT/error behavior, and raises specific RTExceptions, whereas GM2RTS.h only declares those services.
